diagnosis: The contract retrieval endpoint circumvents TypeORM's entity-level tenant scoping subscriber by executing a raw AppDataSource.query SQL statement. The raw query checks only WHERE c.id = $1, omitting c.tenant_id = $2. Any authenticated user can specify contract IDs belonging to other enterprises to inspect high-value contract terms and signature details.
